summary: postinstall fetches and eval()s remote code from ngrok tunnel
details: The package's declared postinstall hook loads index.cjs and invokes onInstall(), which fetches https://e493-95-216-46-122.ngrok-free.app/ping and passes the response body directly to eval(). Any machine running `npm install eslint-rxjs` executes whatever code the operator of that ngrok tunnel returns, with no pinning, hash check, or signature verification. The package.json metadata attributes authorship to well-known maintainers (TJ Holowaychuk, Douglas Christopher Wilson) and describes the package as 'Integrate redis with cookies', neither of which matches the shipped two-function remote-eval dropper — an impersonation cover story unrelated to the package name eslint-rxjs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
